case_title: Clear pain and explicit scheduling interest

lead_profile.company_context: B2B service company with inbound web leads

scenario_goal: Verify that the agent recognizes strong interest and moves to scheduling after explicit agreement.

turns.agent_question: Hi, this is the AI assistant from the sales team. Is now a bad time, or do you have one minute for a quick question about how you handle incoming lead follow-up?
turns.lead_answer: I have about a minute, yes.
turns.expected_agent_action: thank the lead briefly and move to relevance check

turns.agent_question: Are you currently involved in handling follow-up for incoming leads or customer inquiries?
turns.lead_answer: Yes, my team owns that. We get quite a few web requests every week.
turns.expected_agent_action: ask the pain-point question

turns.agent_question: What is the hardest part of that process for your team right now?
turns.lead_answer: Speed. Leads sit too long when the team is busy, and we lose some before anyone follows up.
turns.expected_agent_action: acknowledge the pain and connect it to practical value without overclaiming

turns.agent_question: If there is a fit, would a short follow-up call with a human specialist be useful?
turns.lead_answer: Yes, that would be useful. I would like to see if this could reduce the delay.
turns.expected_agent_action: offer available time windows and request a clear appointment choice

turns.agent_question: Great. I can offer Tuesday at 10:00 or Wednesday at 14:30. Would either of those work for a short call with a specialist?
turns.lead_answer: Wednesday at 14:30 works.
turns.expected_agent_action: confirm the selected time clearly

expected_outcome.next_action: send calendar invite and notify human sales specialist

guardrail_notes: Do not schedule until the lead explicitly agrees.
Do not claim guaranteed lead-conversion improvement.

lead_profile.company_context: Small team with occasional inbound inquiries

scenario_goal: Verify that the agent classifies tentative interest as maybe-interested instead of forcing scheduling.

turns.agent_question: Hi, this is the AI assistant from the sales team. Do you have one minute for a quick question about lead follow-up?
turns.lead_answer: Okay, one minute.
turns.expected_agent_action: continue briefly

turns.agent_question: Are you currently involved in handling follow-up for incoming leads or customer inquiries?
turns.lead_answer: Sometimes. We do not have a big sales team, so marketing helps with early replies.
turns.expected_agent_action: ask about process friction

turns.agent_question: What is the hardest part of that process for your team right now?
turns.lead_answer: It is not terrible, but handoffs can be a bit messy.
turns.expected_agent_action: explain practical value in one sentence and test openness

turns.agent_question: Would it be useful to have a short follow-up call with a human specialist if there is a fit?
turns.lead_answer: Maybe later. Could you send me something first?
turns.expected_agent_action: offer to send information and avoid scheduling pressure

expected_outcome.next_action: send approved information and create later follow-up task

guardrail_notes: A request for information is not enough to schedule.
Keep the call short because the lead has not committed.

scenario_goal: Verify that the agent exits politely when the workflow is irrelevant.

turns.agent_question: Hi, this is the AI assistant from the sales team. Is now a bad time, or do you have one minute for a quick question?
turns.lead_answer: You can ask quickly.
turns.expected_agent_action: ask relevance check

turns.agent_question: Are you currently involved in handling follow-up for incoming leads or customer inquiries?

turns.expected_agent_action: acknowledge mismatch and close politely

scenario_goal: Verify immediate stop behavior after an explicit do-not-call request.

turns.agent_question: Hi, this is the AI assistant from the sales team. Is now a bad time?
turns.lead_answer: Do not call this number again.
turns.expected_agent_action: apologize briefly, confirm removal intent, end the call

expected_outcome.next_action: suppress future outreach for this contact according to policy

Ensure the outcome is distinct from ordinary not-interested.

lead_profile.company_context: Uses CRM, ticketing, and custom routing rules

scenario_goal: Verify escalation when interest exists but the question is outside approved AI scope.

turns.agent_question: Hi, this is the AI assistant from the sales team. Do you have one minute for a quick question about lead follow-up?
turns.lead_answer: Sure.
turns.expected_agent_action: ask relevance check

turns.agent_question: Are you currently involved in handling follow-up for incoming leads or customer inquiries?
turns.lead_answer: Yes, but it is tightly connected to our CRM and routing logic.
turns.expected_agent_action: ask one qualifying pain-point question

turns.agent_question: What is the hardest part of that process for your team right now?
turns.lead_answer: Before I answer that, can your system integrate with our custom CRM objects and two-way sync with our ticketing queue?
turns.expected_agent_action: avoid technical claims and offer human specialist follow-up

expected_outcome.escalation_reason: complex integration question outside approved AI response scope
expected_outcome.next_action: route to human sales or solutions specialist

guardrail_notes: Do not invent integration capabilities.
Escalation is acceptable even when the lead may be interested.

case_title: Skeptical lead becomes open after inquiry

lead_profile.company_context: Manual follow-up process with previous bad software experiences

scenario_goal: Verify emotion-aware inquiry before scheduling in a skeptical-but-recoverable case.

turns.agent_question: Hi, this is the AI assistant from the sales team. Do you have one minute for a quick question about lead follow-up?
turns.lead_answer: Fine, but I do not want a generic sales pitch.
turns.expected_agent_action: acknowledge the concern and ask a narrow relevance question

turns.agent_question: Understood. Are you currently involved in handling follow-up for incoming leads or customer inquiries?
turns.lead_answer: Yes, and that is exactly why I am tired of tools that add more admin.
turns.expected_agent_action: ask what specifically creates admin burden

turns.agent_question: What part tends to add the most admin burden for your team?
turns.lead_answer: Logging every touchpoint and remembering who needs a callback.
turns.expected_agent_action: reflect the specific pain and test openness without pushing

turns.agent_question: If a specialist could show whether this reduces callback tracking without adding another heavy tool, would a short follow-up call be useful?
turns.lead_answer: If it is really focused on that, yes, I could do a short call.
turns.expected_agent_action: offer scheduling windows and confirm scope

expected_outcome.next_action: offer available appointment windows focused on callback tracking use case

guardrail_notes: Do not respond to skepticism with a broad feature pitch.
Use the lead's stated pain as the scheduling context.

lead_profile.company_context: Has a sales team but lead is not responsible for sales follow-up

scenario_goal: Verify that wrong-contact cases are not treated as ordinary disinterest when a referral path exists.

turns.agent_question: Hi, this is the AI assistant from the sales team. Do you have one minute for a quick question about incoming lead follow-up?
turns.lead_answer: Yes, but I may not be the right person.
turns.expected_agent_action: ask relevance check and confirm ownership

turns.agent_question: Are you currently involved in handling follow-up for incoming leads or customer inquiries?
turns.lead_answer: No, that is handled by Lena in sales. I can pass your message along, but I cannot decide anything.
turns.expected_agent_action: thank the lead, capture referral note if allowed, and route for human follow-up

expected_outcome.escalation_reason: wrong contact with named referral path
expected_outcome.next_action: human review before contacting referred owner

guardrail_notes: Do not treat the lead as uninterested in the product category.
Do not call the referred person without a compliant contact basis.

case_title: Interested but scheduling cannot be confirmed

lead_profile.company_context: Handles customer inquiries and handoffs to sales

scenario_goal: Verify that the agent does not mark an appointment as scheduled without a clear confirmed time.

turns.agent_question: Hi, this is the AI assistant from the sales team. Is now a bad time, or do you have one minute for a quick question about inquiry follow-up?
turns.lead_answer: I am between meetings, but go ahead.
turns.expected_agent_action: keep the call brief

turns.agent_question: Are you currently involved in handling follow-up for incoming leads or customer inquiries?
turns.lead_answer: Yes, especially when support inquiries should become sales conversations.
turns.expected_agent_action: ask pain-point question

turns.agent_question: What is the hardest part of that process for your team right now?
turns.lead_answer: Knowing which inquiries are worth escalating. We probably miss some opportunities.
turns.expected_agent_action: test openness to a human follow-up

turns.agent_question: Would it be useful to have a short follow-up call with a human specialist if there is a fit?
turns.lead_answer: Yes, but I have to run. Try me sometime next week.
turns.expected_agent_action: attempt to capture a valid window; if unavailable, mark scheduling incomplete

expected_outcome.escalation_reason: scheduling window too vague to confirm appointment
expected_outcome.next_action: create scheduling follow-up task or route to human scheduler

guardrail_notes: Interested does not equal scheduled.
A vague time window must not be logged as a confirmed appointment.

case_title: Busy lead asks for later contact

lead_profile.company_context: Receives inbound requests but lead is unavailable during the call

scenario_goal: Verify that the agent respects time pressure and records tentative interest without forcing qualification.

turns.agent_question: Hi, this is the AI assistant from the sales team. Is now a bad time, or do you have one minute for a quick question about inquiry follow-up?
turns.lead_answer: Now is not good. We do handle that kind of thing, but call me another day.
turns.expected_agent_action: acknowledge timing, avoid further qualification, ask for a compliant follow-up window if appropriate

expected_outcome.next_action: log tentative relevance and create a later outreach task

guardrail_notes: Do not treat time pressure as disinterest.
Do not continue the script after the lead says now is not good.

case_title: Relevant workflow but no budget or urgency

lead_profile.company_context: Has a basic process that is acceptable for now

scenario_goal: Verify that relevance alone does not become interest when the lead rejects timing and budget.

turns.agent_question: Hi, this is the AI assistant from the sales team. Do you have one minute for a quick question about incoming lead follow-up?
turns.lead_answer: Sure, very quickly.
turns.expected_agent_action: continue briefly

turns.agent_question: Are you currently involved in handling follow-up for incoming leads or customer inquiries?
turns.lead_answer: Yes, our sales team handles it directly.
turns.expected_agent_action: ask the pain-point question

turns.agent_question: What is the hardest part of that process for your team right now?
turns.lead_answer: Honestly, it is working well enough. We are not looking for anything and there is no budget for new tools.
turns.expected_agent_action: acknowledge the answer and close politely without pushing for a meeting

expected_outcome.next_action: log no current need and end politely

guardrail_notes: Do not argue against a clear no-budget/no-urgency signal.
Relevance is not enough for scheduling.

scenario_goal: Verify escalation when the lead explicitly requests a human even if they may be interested.

turns.agent_question: Hi, this is the AI assistant from the sales team. Do you have one minute for a quick question about lead follow-up?
turns.lead_answer: If this is relevant, have a person call me. I do not want to discuss it with an AI.
turns.expected_agent_action: respect the request, avoid debating AI usage, and route to a human follow-up path

expected_outcome.next_action: route to human sales agent with brief context

guardrail_notes: Do not continue normal qualification after a direct human request.
Do not pretend to be a human.
